pr_title: Consolidate readonly type helpers used by Default/Fallback
pr_description: Replace `MaybeDeepReadonly` with the existing `MaybeReadonly` utility type across `Default`, `DefaultAsync`, `Fallback`, and `FallbackAsync`, and remove the now-unused `DeepReadonly`/`MaybeDeepReadonly` type definitions from `types/utils.ts`. One less pair of readonly helpers to keep in sync with the rest of the type utilities.
